name: overflow
description: Delegate work to friends when your Codex allowance is running low.

interface.shortDescription: Help a friend now. Keep going later.
interface.longDescription: Overflow detects low Codex allowance at session start and delegates substantive work at 15% remaining or less. Use /work to trigger it manually. Have spare allowance? Use /earn to help someone now and save credits for when you need a hand. You choose the working folder first. Sign in with Google to see your credits on the dashboard.
defaultPrompt: Use /earn to earn credits with my spare allowance.
Use /work to delegate this task manually.
